title: Update generator integration fixtures for reviewed standalone assurance intake
description:
Parent: Ligature port-feedback epic #143.
Blocks: release verification and downstream handoff #161.
Related behavior fix: #162 (standalone reviewed-obligation assurance intake).
Downstream verification: /home/goya/storage/full-ligature-port-workspace/date-creusot, current project commit f11ff53 (the approved workflow evidence was generated from base revision 729f0432c90dd7916bdbeecb750b9d5abbbbf5cd).

Review of Ligature 1.4.0 source 38e23b4188728abf19ec29e67ff6341c9daf8d8a, bundle SHA-256 1f04052e4fea0441bc807c4caf2c80ecad4d70b7f9f101665185eae7aa46dc9e. The focused command
`PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_work_package_manifest.py tests/test_satisfies.py tests/test_record_assurance.py tests/test_generate_work_package.py`
reported 158 passed and 3 failed. The passing standalone-intake, scope, and regeneration unit regressions pass; all 3 failures occur in legacy IntegratedWorkspace tests before their assertions, because their generated package declares standalone `TaskQueue.C003` but the fixture has no approved TaskQueue concept spec and no interaction `required_assurance` source.

Minimal reproduction: construct the existing tests/test_generate_work_package.py::IntegratedWorkspace fixture, issue its valid manifest grant, and call its `generate()`. Observed exit 2:
`{"error":{"code":"missing-source","message":"no interaction reliance declares required_assurance for obligation 'TaskQueue.C003', and no reviewed concept spec declares concept 'TaskQueue'; the derivation will not invent one"}}`.
Affected tests:
- `test_real_generation_passes_validator_and_is_consumed_by_project_gates`
- `test_downstream_validation_and_check_reject_tampered_generated_fields`
- `test_gate_integrity_is_derived_from_live_files_and_stale_runners_block`

This is consistent with #162's fail-closed behavior; the fixture is now incomplete under the revised assurance-source contract. The actual date-creusot nine-obligation plan generates and passes live G14 on 1.4.0.

Acceptance: update the integration fixture through test-only setup to provide an approved concept constraint for TaskQueue.C003 or a legitimate reviewed interaction reliance, without weakening #162's source validation. Rerun the four focused suites above and confirm all pass. Do not change production behavior merely to admit an unreviewed fixture.
